contracted_signal.note: contracted signal is (near) always-long with ~0 turnover; cost impact is negligible, so this is NOT a valid test of momentum cost robustness

cost_robustness.rule: N0==0 -> NO_ZERO_COST_EDGE; else majority=N0//2+1: N_realistic>=majority -> COST_ROBUST; 1<=N_realistic<majority -> COST_DEGRADED; N_realistic==0 -> COST_COLLAPSES

signal_integrity.definition: sign(mean(log(close[i-lookback+1:i+1]))) -- sign of an average price level, not a return
